verses.translation: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Idumea.

translations.ron: Dumnezeule, Dumnezeul meu, pe Tine Te caut dis-de-dimineaţă.
translations.grk: Ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυὶδ, ἐν τῷ εἶναι αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τῆς Ἰδουμαίας.

verses.translation: O God, my God, I cry to thee early; my soul has thirsted for thee: how often has my flesh longed after thee, in a barren and trackless and dry land!

translations.ron: Însetat-a de Tine sufletul meu, suspinat-a după Tine trupul meu,
translations.grk: Ὁ Θεὸς ὁ Θεός μου πρὸς σὲ ὀρθρίζω, ἐδίψησέ σοι ἡ ψυχή μου, ποσαπλῶς σοι ἡ σάρξ μου, ἐν γῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ ἀβάτῳ καὶ ἀνύδρῳ,

verses.translation: Thus have I appeared before thee in the sanctuary, that I might see thy power and thy glory.

translations.ron: În pământ pustiu şi neumblat şi fără de apă. Aşa în locul cel sfânt m-am arătat Ţie, ca să văd puterea Ta şi slava Ta.
translations.grk: οὕτως ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ ὤφθην σοι, τοῦ ἰδεῖν τὴν δύναμίν σου καὶ τὴν δόξαν σου.

verses.translation: For thy mercy is better than life: my lips shall praise thee.

translations.ron: Că mai bună este mila Ta decât viaţa; buzele mele Te vor lăuda.
translations.grk: Ὅτι κρεῖσσον τὸ ἔλεός σου ὑπὲρ ζωὰς, τὰ χείλη μου ἐπαινέσουσί σε.

verses.translation: Thus will I bless thee during my life: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

translations.ron: Aşa Te voi binecuvânta în viaţa mea şi în numele Tău voi ridica mâinile mele.
translations.grk: Οὕτως εὐλογήσω σε ἐν τῇ ζωῇ μου, ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἀρῶ τὰς χεῖράς μου.

verses.translation: Let my soul be filled as with marrow and fatness; and my joyful lips shall praise thy name.

translations.ron: Ca de seu şi de grăsime să se sature sufletul meu şi cu buze de bucurie Te va lăuda gura mea.
translations.grk: Ὡσεὶ στέατος καὶ πιότητος ἐμπλησθείη ἡ ψυχή μου, καὶ χείλη ἀγαλλιάσεως αἰνέσει τὸ ὄνομά σου.

verses.translation: Forasmuch as I have remembered thee on my bed: in the early seasons I have meditated on thee.

translations.ron: De mi-am adus aminte de Tine în aşternutul meu, în dimineţi am cugetat la Tine, că ai fost ajutorul meu
translations.grk: Εἰ ἐμνημόνευόν σου ἐπὶ τῆς στρωμνῆς μου, ἐν τοῖς ὄρθροις ἐμελέτων εἰς σέ.

verses.translation: For thou hast been my helper, and in the shelter of thy wings will I rejoice.

translations.ron: Şi întru acoperământul aripilor Tale mă voi bucura. Lipitu-s-a sufletul meu de Tine şi pe mine m-a sprijinit dreapta Ta.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐγενήθης βοηθός μου, καὶ ἐν τῇ σκέπῃ τῶν πτερύγων σου ἀγαλλιάσομαι.

verses.translation: My soul has kept very close behind thee: thy right hand has upheld me.

translations.ron: Iar ei în deşert au căutat sufletul meu, intra-vor în cele mai de jos ale pământului; da-se-vor în mâinile sabiei, părţi vulpilor vor fi.
translations.grk: Ἐκολλήθη ἡ ψυχή μου ὀπίσω σου, ἐμοῦ ἀντελάβετο ἡ δεξιά σου.

verses.translation: But they vainly sought after my soul; they shall go into the lowest parts of the earth.

translations.ron: Iar împăratul se va veseli de Dumnezeu; lăuda-se-va tot cel ce se jură întru El, că s-a astupat gura celor ce grăiesc nedreptăţi.
translations.grk: Αὐτοὶ δὲ εἰς μάτην ἐζήτησαν τὴν ψυχήν μου, εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὰ κατώτατα τῆς γῆς,

verses.translation: They shall be delivered up to the power of the sword; they shall be portions for foxes.

translations.grk: παραδοθήσονται εἰς χεῖρας ῥομφαίας, μερίδες ἀλωπέκων ἔσονται.

verses.translation: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that swears by him shall be praised; for the mouth of them that speak unjust things has been stopped.

translations.grk: Ὁ δὲ βασιλεὺς εὐφρανθήσεται ἐπὶ τῷ Θεῷ, ἐπαινεθήσεται πᾶς ὁ ὀμνύων ἐν αὐτῷ, ὅτι ἐνεφράγη στόμα λαλούντων ἄδικα.
